verdict.rationale: The only founder-targeted commercial offer in the evidence is free Deel HR access advertised on the founders immigration page. That loosely resembles founder pricing but is not tied to any accelerator, VC, or founder-community program. The 'trusted partners' cited are health-coverage and rental providers, not startup-ecosystem partners. Missing for 10: documented YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, explicit founder-community discount terms, and any independent corroboration.
